title: Concept: Weak response control (protocol-relative Location)
description: A protocol-relative Location value has no scheme of its own, so the browser reuses the scheme of the request that produced the response.
risk: A redirect built with a protocol-relative target can be followed to an attacker-chosen host on the same scheme, which supports phishing and token leakage; MEDIUM severity because the rule reports the shape and the reviewer still has to confirm the target is attacker-controlled.
